standards.repository_precedence: Repository prohibition on cargo fmt --all takes precedence over attachment command example; no Cargo run.

findings.contract: stored means selected from a fresh stored entry, not a just-completed new or shared resolution
findings.cause: Answer::Wait conflates cached_entry, pending and new work; receiver.borrow().is_some after spawn/join uses readiness as provenance. A worker may publish before this borrow.
findings.effect: New/shared address answers may receive zero HTTPS-record extra wait rather than bounded 5-50 ms, changing ECH offered state depending on scheduling.
findings.remedy: Carry a Stored versus shared/new Answer distinction selected under the cache lock. Keep inline/IP/override/new/joined paths false. Preserve A4 reservation/generation lifetime safeguards.
findings.regression: Deterministically select new/joined work, force actual Publisher readiness before consuming it, assert false. Actual stored positive true; literal/override/inline false. No probabilistic loop or timing-only oracle.
findings.status: source-confirmed; no runtime reproduction performed here

findings.contract: non-absence interface failures retain their OS error and operation context
findings.cause: lookup_failed borrows the original error but reconstructs kind plus text. Interface callers then stringify again in source_binding::interface_error. source_binding::bind_error does the same for source-address bind failure.
findings.effect: Category/text survive but original OS code/cause is inaccessible; lookup rustdoc and FFI audit claim otherwise.
findings.remedy: Move original io::Error through concrete context owners with source linkage, or return unchanged when no context is needed. Fix both interface and source-address wrappers so preserving one layer is not immediately undone. Keep normalized missing-interface NotFound and malformed-input InvalidInput distinct.
findings.regression: Inject a raw OS error sentinel through lookup and every contextual wrapper, then find the original io::Error and code through its retained source/get_ref contract. Assert context and kind separately. Include a typed custom source sentinel and absence/invalid-name positive controls.
findings.status: source-confirmed; no actual OS failure injection

findings.contract: supplied engineering standard requires retaining original underlying causes across failure translation
findings.cause: Outcome::from_result replaces original io::Error with kind and to_string; addresses creates another kind+String error. This affects first shared, joined, stored negative and inline-over-bound failures.
findings.effect: Resolver-specific error object and its source chain cannot be inspected after enabling cache. Uncached HostResolver propagates it intact; facade wrappers preserve only the already-truncated error.
findings.public_contract_qualification: ClientBuilder::address_resolver docs at client.rs:1090-1093 explicitly describe kind/message-only cached errors. This is an existing documented limitation, not an invented prior promise that cache preserves all types. It conflicts with the supplied standard and broader RequestError original-type/source wording.
findings.remedy: Keep one Arc-owned original io::Error and a small cloneable concrete contextual source per delivered io::Error. Preserve outer kind/message behavior. Do not require outer raw_os_error Some when context is added; require access to the original nested io::Error/raw code or get_ref typed cause. Update specific cache docs to the strengthened contract.
findings.regression: Actual public AddressResolver::from_fn returns independent typed sentinel with a nested source; compare uncached and cached first/joined/stored/inline paths for retained sentinel and nested cause. Add raw OS sentinel separate from custom error and preserve negative TTL/call-count controls.
findings.status: source-confirmed standards mismatch; root reproduction/remedy pending

boundary_traces: new/joined lookup -> Answer::Wait -> publication before borrow -> stored=true -> HostResolver passthrough -> TCP/QUIC extra_time ZERO -> ECH list may be discarded
AddressResolver error -> Outcome::Failed(kind,message) -> new io::Error -> DirectConnectError -> Http1TlsError::Connect -> RequestError retained transport source; original resolver cause already gone
Unix errno or Windows IP Helper status -> lookup_failed text -> source_binding interface_error text -> TCP bind/connect failure -> same public transport error chain
Source address bind OS error -> bind_error text -> TCP failure; original cause also gone
existing_control_assessment: Address cache failure tests assert kind/message and resolver counts, not original typed causes or cache provenance after fast publication.
HostResolver error tests compare cached/uncached kind/message only; real overrides/literals have separate address/call-count controls.
Source-binding tests observe actual loopback/unknown interface and names/categories but do not inject non-absence OS failures or inspect original source codes.
Clear/runtime/inline controls were partially read to ensure provenance repair must not weaken A4 state ownership; no new full-test-file credit.
rejected_overreach: Sharing does not imply that error causes must be discarded; Arc-owned error preserves one original object without copying arbitrary error types.
No demand for top-level raw_os_error Some on an io::Error that intentionally adds context; original cause recoverability is the requirement.
No allegation of new unsafe, pointer escape, changed FFI behavior, platform execution failure, credential exposure or network bypass from these reads.
No blanket logging-redaction claim for explicit low-level source inspection; facade outer formatting remains its separate contract.
No crate split, cache generic framework, new DNS protocol or arbitrary resource limit justified.
limitations: No builds, Cargo, network, native OS failure injection, tests or gate runs executed by this reviewer.
Five modules freshly read in full; supporting files are partial at explicit ranges. Prior reports supply orientation only.
Known A4 ownership safeguards were read and must remain; this report does not reopen them as unbounded tasks.
Public client explicitly documents cached kind/message behavior. A strengthening requires documentation update rather than pretending the old contract already promised it.
Exact source equals earlier baselines as recorded; pending fix lanes are not approved by this source disposition.
Full architecture audit, browser parity, all-platform behavior and runtime regression proof remain outside this bounded pass.
